# Model Overview

## Description

This is a copy of [NVIDIA Gemma 4 26B A4B NVFP4](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Gemma-4-26B-A4B-NVFP4), a quantized variant of [Google Gemma 4 26B A4B IT](https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it).

The intent is to provide NVIDIA's weights with the latest configuration updates from Google applied on top.

Refer to the original model cards linked above for model descriptions, capabilities, benchmarks, usage and limitations.
